steps.title: Talk to Hardin – accept the quest
Collect 35 Ectoplasm from the Forest of Mirrors ghosts
Bring the ectoplasm to Errickin (talk twice)
Bring the Stabilized Ectoplasm to Hardin

Does that mean the soul has to be transformed as well?
Is it even possible to transform the soul? Moreover, if the soul transforms, wouldn't there be a loss of identity?
Can you get me Stabilized Ectoplasm? What will be the price?
